content: I've been experimenting with some visual way to get a sense of whats in Tau Ceti as well as the progress so far. To this end I made this, it shows the roadmaps that we have (completed or not) and a very rough % completion of everything, done by simply counting how many layers in the roadmaps have been done. This isnt very accurate, since some will hide more than others, but maybe this averages out. The idea is that as more gets done, each cluster gets brighter. This is essentially a progress bar for Tau Ceti and any feedback would be very welcome! More roadmaps are comming, so going forward I think it might be useful to have a way to at a glance get an idea of whats going on in Tau Ceti.
I should say that we also have this which has more details of the progress of each roadmap.

Following a suggestion by @William Coram atlas also now shows "live" PRs in the form of little stars that twinkle. They show what roadmaps currently have a PR open in that area and disappear once the PR merges. You can see it here (it may take a few seconds to show up when you first open)
I tried zoom in to some areas my agents are working on and didn't see the twinkle PRs, turns out they are around clusters, sometimes an empty cluster. :joy:
you can click on them and they take you to the PR
